description: Svelte actions (use:, M6 script DOM slice 4) compared with Chromium: the action runs once with the element and its value; update runs again when what the value reads changes: deep inside a proxy value (a nested and a top-level field), inside a proxy a plain object holds at its top level, not for a proxy inside a plain object inside the value (Svelte's deep_read_state), for a primitive prop when it changes and not when the same value is set, and not for unrelated state; destroy runs when the element's component is destroyed
